title: factdiff.old_passage builds its revision path with backslashes on Windows, so it never reads the snapshot at HEAD
goal: factdiff.old_passage reads the snapshot at HEAD on Windows: the path it gives git cat-file uses forward slashes (os.path.relpath gives backslashes there, which git does not match against tree paths), and TestRevisionReadsWithoutGitShow plants the snapshot in a subdirectory, so the separator is exercised and the test fails when the path is native.

run: import re,pathlib,sys; t=pathlib.Path('_tools/factdiff.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); m=re.search(r'def old_passage.*?(?=\ndef )', t, re.S); b=m.group(0) if m else ''; sys.exit(1 if 'relpath(snapshot_path(sid), kbcommon.HOME)' in b and 'as_posix' not in b and 'os.sep' not in b else 0)
